753:t_207:20.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Come, $n! If you can do it, then try!!」

753:t_207:21.en:
$n
「We surpass hope, despair and the past to seek a future! That's what it means to be human!!」

753:t_208:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$號$$, apostle of $$ゲッター線$$... You guided Earth's humanity?」

753:t_208:3.en:
$$凱$$
「We're one to the very end! Let's unite our three hearts and charge that god bastard!」

753:t_208:4.en:
$$號$$
「Yes. Living and moving forward together is the truth of life.」

753:t_208:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I shall teach you that a being exists who surpasses that.」

753:t_208:6.en:
$$號$$
「Then we'll surpass you and move forward!」

753:t_209:0.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「We face the universe's administrators, the $$御使い$$s... and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, who has surpassed even them...」

753:t_209:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We've certainly come a long way.」

753:t_209:2.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「We've traveled to the center of the galaxy, then returned to Earth from there.」

753:t_209:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But what we must protect is on that very planet.」

753:t_209:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That journey of battle ends here. You will perish with the universe and receive new lives in a new world.」

753:t_209:5.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We'll decline. We like this world.」

753:t_209:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So we'll resist with all our strength... staking our human pride.」

753:t_209:7.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, charge! With our strength, we'll clear the fog shrouding this universe's future!!」

753:t_210:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All guns, aim! We'll settle all this fighting here!」

753:t_210:1.en:
$$メラン$$
「All sections are functioning normally! We're ready at any time!」

753:t_210:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You resist without abandoning hope to the last moment... That's what I'd expect from a ship captained by a man who sustained the civilization of fire.」

753:t_210:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I shall reward that exemplary display of military spirit.」

753:t_210:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Don't listen to the enemy's taunts! We need results, regardless of the process!」

753:t_210:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll win at any cost! Everyone, remember that people's future depends on our actions!!」

753:t_211:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「Everyone, give it your all! This is our final battle!」

753:t_211:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「All sections, confirm your status!」

753:t_211:2.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「There are no problems! Everyone is at their station!」

753:t_211:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You face me out of a sense of duty... Ignorance is frightening.」

753:t_211:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「What's wrong with soldiers fulfilling their mission!? We'll carry it out with all our strength for the civilians!」

753:t_211:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「But let me add this! On behalf of the whole universe, this ship will land a blow on that infuriating smirk of yours!」

753:t_211:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「Let's do this, everyone! We'll show that phony god what we're really made of!!」

753:t_212:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Our opponent calls himself God...! Whatever he is, we have to acknowledge his power...!」

753:t_212:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「We challenged the entire world! We're not going to flinch now!」

753:t_212:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We made our resolve long ago!」

753:t_212:3.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Whatever our opponent is, $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ is still $$ソレスタルビーイング$$!」

753:t_212:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You have come this far following $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$'s plan. Today, you will be released from your mission.」

753:t_212:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$イオリア$$'s plan doesn't matter anymore! We're taking part in this battle of our own free will!」

753:t_212:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「And alongside our comrades, we'll protect the people who believe in this world's future!」

753:t_212:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Everyone, begin the attack! The final mission starts now!!」

753:t_213:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This is the moment of truth, boys! We'll throw in every ounce of strength we have left!!」

753:t_213:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「The boss is fired up too!」

753:t_213:4.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「It's a battle for the universe's fate...!」

753:t_213:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Let's fight as one, every member of the $$マクロス・クォーター$$'s staff!」

753:t_213:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The ship and its entire crew have achieved $$真化融合$$...!」

753:t_213:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That is our bond... the bond of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$!」

753:t_213:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$マクロス$$ is the name of a ship that opens the way to an infinite future! We'll show you its power, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!!」

753:t_214:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I did something terrible to $$レナード$$.」

753:t_214:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So, $$テッサ$$... I shall take you to the new world in his place. You can create your ideal family there.」

753:t_214:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You too ignore the sacrifices paid along the way, as long as the result is good.」

753:t_214:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You're a pathetic dictator for someone calling himself God! Your scale is bigger, but your selfishness is no different from any common fool's!」

753:t_214:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is unpleasant. I am a being who has surpassed even the $$御使い$$s.」

753:t_214:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then I'll ruin every one of your plans by defeating you!」

753:t_214:7.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「We are already prepared to attack.」

753:t_214:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Attention, all hands! With courage and pride, we'll strike down this great evil and protect the world and the universe!」

753:t_214:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, begin the attack! Teach that presumptuous god who rules the seas of this universe!」

753:t_215:0.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Let's do this, everyone! $$超銀河ダイグレン$$, charge!」

753:t_215:1.en:
$$リーロン$$
「We're ready whenever you are!」

753:t_215:3.en:
$$テツカン$$
「We've got our pride too...」

753:t_215:4.en:
$$シベラ$$
「...as members of $$大グレン団$$, and of $c!」

753:t_215:5.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The deepest wish of every life in this galaxy will now be fulfilled...!」

753:t_215:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You face me knowing it is futile... Your recklessness is almost endearing.」

753:t_215:7.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「It's not futile! This blow will definitely hurt you!」

753:t_215:8.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「$$キヨウ$$, $$アンネ$$! We'll protect your future and the universe's!!」

753:t_216:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That was splendid, $$トライア$$... and $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$.」

753:t_216:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I shall permit you to offer that ship and the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ to $$至高神Ｚ$$.」

753:t_216:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「Don't underestimate this culmination of Earth's wisdom. Give it a little more time, and it'll rival even your $$黒い太陽#sol$$.」

753:t_216:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're completely wrong if you think everything will belong to you!」

753:t_216:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「A devil presumes to lecture God. You are ridiculous, $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$.」

753:t_216:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「You're not the only one he's pissing off.」

753:t_216:7.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「You are the one who obstructs humanity's future...!」

753:t_216:9.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「You are a false god who steals lives through his selfishness...!」

753:t_216:10.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「You are an enemy who steals freedom and peace through his self-righteousness...!」
